newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - April 6.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - April 6.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Dhaka will seek to know from Delhi the reason for drop in the flow of the Ganges at the two-day official level talks beginning in the city on Sunday.
Foreign ministers of Bangladesh, India, Nepal and Bhutan are likely to endorse the formation of a new South Asian grouping styled South Asian Growth Quadrangle.
President Justice Shahabuddin Ahmed summoned parliament to session on May 10.
Opposition Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) will stage demonstrations across the country on Sunday across the country demanding the release of party leader and workers from jails.
Bangladesh's top business leader Yussuf Abdullah Harun has said radical changes are essential in bureaucratic culture to enable the government to play the role of a true facilitator.
Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina said the power generation in the country should be led by the private sector in future.
Aero Bengal Airlines, a local private sector aviation company, launches on Sunday 48-seater aircraft in domestic routes.
Australian Deputy Prime Minister Tim Fischer arrives in Dhaka on Monday on a three-day official visit to Bangladesh.
